dedupe_keys.name: historical and future water demand for households and industry for the stars4water river basins

description: Sylwia Szporak-Wasilewska at Warsaw University of Life Sciences publishes modelled domestic and industrial water demand for 23 European basins and 75 sub-basins through STARS4Water. Historical results cover 2005, 2010, 2015 and 2020; five pathways provide five-year steps from 2020 to 2050. Text files distinguish gross demand and net demand after recycling and reuse, expressed in cubic metres per year. The August 2026 deposit supplies text and Shapefile downloads as model_results.zip and sub_basins.zip free under CC BY 4.0. Missing values use -999, and scientific notation is used. Spatial results require a join from numerical IDs to the supplied GIS layer; that join was not tested. These projections can inform supply-capacity and climate-adaptation simulations. The overlapping historical and projected 2020 values should not be double-counted. Related irrigation results already have a first-review draft, but do not cover these household and industrial quantities. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified.
